scope: Independent review of source implementation and destinations. Browser layout checks and CMake build are handled by root/source agent.

findings.summary: Per-article override keys documented as hyphenated blog slugs are rejected by the existing snake_case-only content parser.
findings.impact: Uncommenting the example medium_posts entry causes a website build failure.
findings.requested_fix: Accept validated blog slugs specifically in medium_posts/linkedin_posts mappings and add a smoke fixture for the documented override.
findings.resolution: Parser now applies the existing blog_title_slug validator only to medium_posts and linkedin_posts keys. Added positive smoke fixtures for both groups and negative fixtures for traversal, underscore slugs, and hyphenated keys in ordinary groups.

passed_checks: Both social icons have explicit accessible link names and decorative aria-hidden SVGs.
Hover and keyboard focus expose bounded tooltip text; Escape dismisses it and no-JavaScript title remains available.
New icon controls reuse paired dark/light blog palette tokens, currentColor SVGs, and existing focus outlines.
Control row and footer navigation wrap; controls have 40px targets.
Medium author profile and LinkedIn company destinations are accurately distinguished in labels and editable YAML.
Article overrides select article-specific tooltips; missing overrides retain public profile URLs.
HTML values pass through the existing escaping path; article destinations require HTTPS and reject whitespace.
All three generated footer templates preserve the author links and add public Medium/company LinkedIn links.
git diff --check passes; parser fix follows the same slug rules as article metadata.
